title: KP Health Department Suspends Recruitment in Selected Districts
excerpt: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Department has halted all hiring processes across health institutions and offices in specific districts.
body_html:
The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Health Department has officially halted all recruitment processes across its health institutions and offices.

According to the details, the suspension applies specifically to selected districts. Recruitment activities at various health facilities within these targeted areas are put on hold until further notice.
